searchMode.title: Search mode
searchMode.description: How to find parcels. catastro_numbers: look up specific parcels. owner_name: owner of record contains this name. municipality: all parcels in a municipality (use with filters). area: parcels inside a bounding box. custom: raw SQL WHERE clause against the CRIM layer.

catastroNumbers.title: Catastro numbers
catastroNumbers.description: One or more catastro numbers. Accepts 11-digit parcel form (XXX-XXX-XXX-XX), full 14-digit with unit (XXX-XXX-XXX-XX-XXX), with or without dashes, spaces or dots.

ownerName.title: Owner name contains
ownerName.description: Owner of record (Dueño) contains this text. Case-insensitive. e.g. RIVERA MORALES

municipio.title: Municipality
municipio.description: Municipality name, e.g. San Juan, Ponce, Bayamón, Río Grande. Case-insensitive.

centerLat.title: Center latitude
centerLat.description: Center point latitude for a radius search. Used with radiusKm.

centerLon.title: Center longitude
centerLon.description: Center point longitude for a radius search. Used with radiusKm.

customWhere.title: Custom WHERE clause
customWhere.description: Raw ArcGIS SQL WHERE clause against the Parcelas layer, e.g. MUNICIPIO = 'Rincon' AND SALESAMT > 100000. Fields: NUM_CATASTRO, MUNICIPIO, CONTACT, DIRECCION_FISICA, DIRECCION_POSTAL, CABIDA, LAND, STRUCTURE, MACHINERY, TOTALVAL, TAXABLE, DEEDBOOK, DEEDPAGE, ESTATE, DEEDNUM, SALESAMT, SALESDTTM, SELLERNAME, BYERNAME, TIPO.

parcelType.title: Parcel type
parcelType.description: TIPO filter: P = parcela (land parcel). Leave empty for all.

hasSale.title: Only parcels with a recorded sale
hasSale.description: Return only parcels where CRIM records a sale price (SALESAMT > 0).

saleYearFrom.title: Sale year from
saleYearFrom.description: Only parcels last sold in this year or later, e.g. 2020.

saleYearTo.title: Sale year to
saleYearTo.description: Only parcels last sold in this year or earlier.

absenteeOnly.title: Only absentee owners
absenteeOnly.description: Owner mailing address differs from the parcel's physical address.

minTotalValue.title: Min total assessed value
minTotalValue.description: TOTALVAL at or above this amount (USD).

maxTotalValue.title: Max total assessed value
maxTotalValue.description: TOTALVAL at or below this amount (USD).

minCabidaM2.title: Min lot size (m2)
minCabidaM2.description: Cabida (lot area) at or above this, in square meters.

maxCabidaM2.title: Max lot size (m2)
maxCabidaM2.description: Cabida (lot area) at or below this, in square meters.

maxItems.title: Max results
maxItems.description: Maximum number of parcels to return.

includeGeometry.title: Include parcel geometry
includeGeometry.description: Include the parcel polygon (GeoJSON geometry field) in each result. Makes results heavier.
